# Tech-regnskaber løfter stemningen og friske tal fra DSV

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-21  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The Danish Millionærklubben panel (EuroInvestor, sponsored by Saxo Bank) covers a busy earnings day, with guests Thomas J. Larsen and Michael Frisch Jørgensen. The episode includes an interview with Embla Medical's CEO after a weak Q3 reaction and an organic growth guidance cut. DSV's Q3 brought relief: the stock rose ~6% on buybacks and signs that the Road division stabilised in September. Strong SpaceX and Supermicro reports confirmed tight AI data-center capacity, but both panelists see a shake-out in which hyperscalers win and leveraged neoclouds/SPV-financed data centers struggle. Thomas prefers 'picks and shovels' such as ABB and NKT. Michael is considering Tesla as a merger-arbitrage trade on a possible SpaceX combination.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 DSV — DSV | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Thomas holds a large position; Road stabilised in September, buyback, Air & Sea and Contract Logistics beat; confident Schenker synergies will be delivered.

#### Reasoning

Thomas (guest) sees the Road problem as plugged: customers' service levels are back and September stabilised. The other divisions are beating expectations and a buyback adds support. Synergies are delayed because DSV is spending on price to win back customers. He expects a return to market growth in 2027 and eventual synergy delivery. Michael is more cautious and calls it no clean report.

#### Sell Triggers

- Road volumes fail to return to market growth
- customers not won back from Kühne+Nagel
- further delay or cut of Schenker synergies
- margin hit from price competition

> *"Men jeg er nu egentlig ret fortrøstningsfuld for, at de også kommer til at levere på de her synergier."*

---

### 🟢 TSLA — Tesla | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Michael considering buying Tesla for the first time to capture a 10-15% premium from a possible SpaceX merger (betting markets ~70%, he says 99%).

#### Reasoning

Michael (guest) sees a SpaceX-Tesla merger as near-certain given Musk's comments and conflicts between related-party listed firms. The trade is a merger-arbitrage bet for a modest premium, not a fundamental view. He expects tonight's Q3 to show pressured cash flow, but says the report matters little for the share price.

#### Sell Triggers

- merger talks abandoned
- deal priced without premium for Tesla holders
- regulatory/board committee rejection

> *"Og overvejer faktisk for første gang i mit liv at købe Tesla, bare for at hente de der 10-15 procent."*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

CDS at 12-14%, debt-financed neocloud; panel sees a shake-out where weaker financed players lose.

#### Reasoning

Thomas notes CoreWeave CDS at 12-14% and data-center bonds down to 88-95 as risk premiums rise. Michael says neoclouds lose contracts on power shortages and investors have rotated to hyperscalers. Both see the lower, leveraged layer of the AI chain as vulnerable.

> *"Deres CDS nu handler på 12-14 procent."*

---

### ⛔ SMCI — Super Micro Computer | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Big guidance raise and +15% after hours, but Michael avoids AI hardware and owns AI exposure via energy instead.

#### Reasoning

Michael acknowledges strong near-term evidence of demand. Still, he has disliked the AI infrastructure sector for months over peak-demand worries, possible overbuild ($8tn) and technology that may cut memory needs. He prefers energy exposure and notes institutional money has left microchips for hyperscalers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if continued blowout reports prove the build-out is sustainable beyond 1-2 years

> *"jeg er med på AI-opturen, men det er jo via energi, som jeg mener, bliver den største faktor"*

---

### 🟡 ABB — ABB | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Thomas is invested; ABB supplies infrastructure for data centers and electrification as a second-order AI play.

#### Reasoning

Thomas spreads his AI exposure into derived beneficiaries rather than concentrated US megacaps (where he is underweight). Energy and electrical infrastructure are the bottleneck for the data-center build-out, and ABB is a key supplier.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI capex cycle stops
- data-center build-out slows materially

> *"Jeg har jo tidligere nævnt, at vi har investeret i ABB."*

---

### 🟠 NKT — NKT | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Thomas cites cables and European electrification as a beneficiary of the AI and power build-out.

#### Reasoning

Thomas names NKT as a second-order beneficiary: data centers and the electrification of Europe need cables. He presents it as part of a diversified AI-derived theme, but does not explicitly say he holds it.

#### Sell Triggers

- electrification investment slows
- AI capex cycle reverses

> *"Jamen, vi skal også være lidt kabler. Det er NKT."*
